subject: general
question:
In the given figure, the area of the unshaded region is 35% of the area of the shaded region. What is the value of x?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8ebaf6f5afa7e3eb5dab34b702bdd7176ff2547d2002d2f97405cf05d13ef38.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

We know that the area of a rectangle = Length × Width

The total area of shaded and unshaded areas = (80 × 50) × 135/100 = 5400 m²

From the option, we can easily adjust the area → (80 + 10) × (50 + 10)

= 90 × 60 = 5400

**So, the value of x is 10**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The length of the shaded region = 80 m

The width of the shaded region = 50 m

The area of the unshaded region = 35% of the area of the shaded region

**Formula used:**

The area of a rectangle = Length × Width

**Calculation:**

[(x + 80) (x + 50)] - (80 × 50) = (80 × 50) × 35/100

⇒ x² + 80x + 50x + 4000 - 4000 = 1400

⇒ x2 + 130x - 1400 = 0

⇒ x2 + 140x - 10x - 1400 = 0

⇒ x (x + 140) - 10 (x + 140) = 0

⇒ (x - 10) (x + 140) = 0

⇒ x - 10 = 0 ⇒ x = 10

⇒ x + 140 = 0 ⇒ x = - 140 ("-" not possible)

**∴ The value of x is 10**
